access.summary: Official Public Domain Business Master API/export; current v3 documentation does not itself prove legacy endpoint transport.

fields: Stable record identifiers, organization facts, registration status, NAICS, business-address ZIP and source location are available; email, survey and person-linked fields remain excluded.
status_semantics: Active registration can coexist with overdue or delinquent filings and is not proof of good standing, operation, licensure, solvency or an open storefront.
address_zip: Reported business address, ZIP and source location are registry assertions rather than verified premises; ZIP5 and ZIP+4 remain separate.
temporal: Registration, reporting and dataset refresh dates have distinct meanings; source refresh is not a continuous-operation observation.
strongest_next_action: Verify and reuse the retained release; require current metadata, schema and transport checks before an app-owned refresh.
